name: btcusd_mock_safety
_comment: Thresholds are deliberately looser than the textbook 30/70. This fixture exists to make the SAFETY layer fire, which needs trades to lose money on — not to validate RSI levels. At 30/70 its 164-bar window offered only 6 entries that passed RSI + Bollinger + the OBV filter together, and the move to Wilder's smoothing (#517) took all six. At 40/60 the same window offers 9, measured 2026-09-14.

deployment._comment: Do this profile's sessions form ONE deployment whose ledger rows join into one history? MANDATORY — there is no safe default. Declare true only on a profile you are actually deploying; the CLI can narrow it (--one-off) but never widen it.
